title: Additional terms: categorical and contextual materiality
shortTitle: Additional terms: categorical and contextual materiality
summary: The materiality notes compare types of clause and kinds of evidence.
notes: Bayway distinguishes a limited invoice tax allocation from an open-ended indemnity. Its surprise analysis includes both personal awareness and what a reasonable merchant should anticipate, informed by practice. Its hardship discussion is conditional and leaves the independent-ground question open. The Union Carbide note states a narrower view of hardship. Arbitration, warranties, forum, and payment terms require attention to the particular court’s formulation.
